questions.question: List all the members of the "School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education" department.
questions.evidence: list all members means to list all the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T2.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

questions.question: Calculate the amount budgeted for 'April Speaker' event. List all the budgeted categories for said event in an ascending order based on their amount budgeted.
questions.evidence: 'April Speaker' is an event name; amount budgeted refers to SUM(amount); budget categories refers to category
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.category, SUM(T2.amount) FROM event AS T1 JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.event_name = 'April Speaker' GROUP BY T2.category ORDER BY SUM(T2.amount) ASC

questions.question: State the category of events were held at MU 215.
questions.evidence: 'MU 215' is the location of event;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215'

questions.question: What was the notes of the fundraising on 2019/9/14?
questions.evidence: fundraising on 2019/9/14 refers to source = 'Fundraising' where date_received = '2019-09-14'
questions.SQL: SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

questions.question: Write the full name of the member who spent money for water, veggie tray and supplies and include the cost of it.
questions.evidence: full name refers to first_name, last name; spent money for refers expense description; expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.first_name, T2.last_name, T1.cost FROM expense AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.link_to_member = T2.member_id WHERE T1.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

questions.question: Mention the total expense used on 8/20/2019.
questions.evidence: total expense refers SUM(cost) where expense_date = '2019-08-20'
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

questions.question: Calculate the difference of the total amount spent in all events by the Student_Club in year 2019 and 2020.
questions.evidence: The first 4 strings of the event_date values in the event table can represent year; The difference of the total amount spent = SUBTRACT(spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2019, spent where YEAR(event_date) = 2020)
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(T1.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020' THEN T2.spent ELSE 0 END) AS num FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event

questions.question: List the last name of members with a major in environmental engineering and include its department and college name.
questions.evidence: 'Environmental Engineering' is the major_name;
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.last_name, T1.department, T1.college FROM major AS T1 INNER JOIN member AS T2 ON T1.major_id = T2.link_to_major WHERE T2.position = 'Member' AND T1.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

questions.question: What is the total amount of money spent for food?
questions.evidence: total amount of money spent refers to SUM(spent); spent for food refers to category = 'Food'
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

questions.question: Did Maya Mclean attend the 'Women's Soccer' event?
questions.evidence: Maya Mclean is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; 'Women's Soccer' is an event_name
questions.SQL: SELECT CASE WHEN T3.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer' THEN 'YES' END AS result FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Maya' AND T1.last_name = 'Mclean'

questions.question: List the names of closed event as "game" that was closed from 3/15/2019 to 3/20/2020.
questions.evidence: name of events refers event_name; game event that was closed refers to type = 'Game' where status = 'Closed'; event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' and '2020-03-20';
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT event_name FROM event WHERE type = 'Game' AND date(SUBSTR(event_date, 1, 10)) BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20' AND status = 'Closed'

questions.question: Write the full names of students who received funds on the date of 9/9/2019 and include the amount received.
questions.evidence: full name refers to first_name, last_name, amount of funds received refers to amount, received funds on date refers to date_received
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T4.amount FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN member AS T3 ON T3.member_id = T2.link_to_member INNER JOIN income AS T4 ON T4.link_to_member = T3.member_id WHERE T4.date_received = '2019-09-09'

questions.question: State the date Connor Hilton paid his/her dues.
questions.evidence: Connor Hilton is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; date the dues was paid refers to date_received where source = 'Dues';
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.date_received FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.first_name = 'Connor' AND T1.last_name = 'Hilton' AND T2.source = 'Dues'

questions.question: What's Angela Sanders's major?
questions.evidence: Angela Sanders is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; major refers to major_name.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Angela' AND T1.last_name = 'Sanders'

questions.question: What was Brent Thomason's major?
questions.evidence: Brent Thomason is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; major refers to major_name
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.major_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN major AS T2 ON T1.link_to_major = T2.major_id WHERE T1.first_name = 'Brent' AND T1.last_name = 'Thomason'

questions.question: Based on the total cost for all event, what is the percentage of cost for Yearly Kickoff event?
questions.evidence: percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(cost where event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'), SUM(cost)) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN T3.cost ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T3.cost) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget

questions.question: Among the members with t-shirt size of medium, what is the percentage of the amount 50 received by the Student_Club?
questions.evidence: t_shirt_size = 'Medium' where position = 'Member'; percentage = DIVIDE(COUNT(amount = 50), COUNT(member_id)) * 100
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.amount = 50 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.income_id) FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Member' AND T1.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

questions.question: What are the budget category of the events located at MU 215 and a guest speaker type with a 0 budget spent?
questions.evidence: budget category refers to category; events located at refers to location; type = 'Guest Speaker'; 0 budget spent refers to spent = 0;
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T2.category, T1.type FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.location = 'MU 215' AND T2.spent = 0 AND T1.type = 'Guest Speaker'

questions.question: Name the event with the highest amount spent on advertisement.
questions.evidence: Name of event refers to event_name; highest amount spent on advertisement refers to MAX(spent) where category = 'Advertisement'
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.event_name FROM budget AS T1 INNER JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id WHERE T1.category = 'Advertisement' ORDER BY T1.spent DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Among the events attended by more than 10 members of the Student_Club, how many of them are meetings?
questions.evidence: meetings events refers to type = 'Meeting'; attended by more than 10 members refers to COUNT(event_id) > 10
questions.SQL: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.event_id) FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event WHERE T1.type = 'Meeting' GROUP BY T1.event_id HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 10

questions.question: Tell the phone number of "Carlo Jacobs".
questions.evidence: Carlo Jacobs is the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name;
questions.SQL: SELECT phone FROM member WHERE first_name = 'Carlo' AND last_name = 'Jacobs'

questions.question: Indicate the cost of posters for 'September Speaker' event.
questions.evidence: 'Posters' is the expense description; 'September Speaker' is an event name
questions.SQL: SELECT T3.cost FROM event AS T1 INNER JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.event_id = T2.link_to_event INNER JOIN expense AS T3 ON T2.budget_id = T3.link_to_budget WHERE T1.event_name = 'September Speaker' AND T3.expense_description = 'Posters'

questions.question: What is the amount of the funds that the Vice President received?
questions.evidence: 'Vice President' is a position of Student Club; funds received refers to amount.
questions.SQL: SELECT T2.amount FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN income AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member WHERE T1.position = 'Vice President'

questions.question: List the name of students that have attended more than 7 events.
questions.evidence: name of students means the full name; full name refers to first_name, last_name; attended more than 7 events refers to COUNT(link_to_event) > 7
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.last_name FROM member AS T1 INNER JOIN attendance AS T2 ON T1.member_id = T2.link_to_member GROUP BY T2.link_to_member HAVING COUNT(T2.link_to_event) > 7
